summary: FR-7..FR-9 implemented additively; expiry is enforced on cache hits and covered with FakeTimeProvider tests. Existing behaviour and tests are unchanged.

findings.issue: New nullable column requires an EF migration for non-development databases.
findings.suggestion: Add a migration before deploying to Postgres.

findings.issue: Cache value shape changed (CachedLink); stale Redis entries from v1 would not deserialize as expected.
findings.suggestion: Bump the cache key prefix when Cache:Provider=Redis.
